title: CRM: Retrieval Model with Controllable Condition
abstract: arXiv:2412.13844v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval models for recommendation need to account for outcomes such as watch time while searching large item corpora efficiently. We present the Controllable Retrieval Model (CRM), an outcome-conditioned retrieval framework that adds watch time as an input to the user tower. During training, CRM learns to predict the next item given its observed watch time; at inference, we supply a desired watch time to steer retrieval without retraining. The item tower is independent of the condition, so item embeddings can still be precomputed and indexed for approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search. We implement CRM as both a DNN-based two-tower model and a Decision Transformer. The Transformer interleaves item tokens with watch-time-to-go condition tokens, using the target watch time as a numerical prompt for next-item prediction. For each online request, we choose between the average and maximum watch times in the user's recent history

translated_title: CRM：具备可控条件的检索模型
translated_abstract: 面向推荐的检索模型需要在高效搜索大规模物品语料库的同时，兼顾观看时长等结果指标。我们提出了可控检索模型，这是一个以结果为条件的检索框架，它将观看时长作为用户塔的输入。在训练阶段，CRM 学习在给定观测到的观看时长的条件下预测下一个物品；在推理阶段，我们输入期望的观看时长来引导检索，而无需重新训练。由于物品塔与该条件无关，物品向量仍然可以被预先计算并建立索引，用于近似最近邻（ANN）搜索。我们将 CRM 同时实现为基于 DNN 的双塔模型和 Decision Transformer 两种形式。其中 Transformer 将物品 token 与剩余观看时长条件 token 交错排列，并使用目标观看时长作为数值提示来进行下一物品预测。对于每个在线请求，我们在用户近期历史记录的平均观看时长与最大观看时长之间进行选择。
tldr: 提出可控检索模型（CRM），将观看时长作为用户塔的条件输入，使模型在推理阶段无需重新训练即可通过指定期望观看时长来引导检索，同时保持物品向量可预先计算以支持高效的 ANN 检索。
